indicator_name: External debt service schedule (principal and interest, forecast) by sector and horizon
description: График погашения внешнего долга РК (основной долг и проценты, прогноз) по секторам и срокам
methodology: NBK formId=346, as at report_date (the first day of the quarter after the reference quarter, like EXTERNAL_DEBT). Item = SECTOR_TYPE_HORIZON: sectors GG, CB, BANKS, OTHER, FDI_LOANS; PRINCIPAL/INTEREST; ON_DEMAND, M01_03 … M22_24, AFTER_2Y, NO_INFO; MEMO_GOODS_* = repayment in goods (a memo item). Principal rows sum to EXTERNAL_DEBT at each date (enforced). Vintages from the API: ['2026-01-01', '2026-04-01']; carried forward from the archive: [].
